WITH event_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    e.type,
    AVG(b.spent / b.amount) as event_avg_rate
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type
),
type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    type,
    AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate
  FROM event_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as overall_avg
  FROM type_rates
)
SELECT 
  t.type,
  t.type_avg_rate,
  t.type_avg_rate / o.overall_avg as normalized_rate
FROM type_rates t
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
ORDER BY t.type
